Kentucky Fried Biscuits
By: Anonymous
Published: Monday, December 28, 2009 - 12:16am

Ingredients




2 cups Bisquick
1/4 cup cold butter
2 tablespoons sugar
1 cup real buttermilk

Preparation

1 Combine Bisquick with butter and mix until crumbly. Sprinkle on sugar. Add buttermilk and mix thoroughly. Knead in bowl. Pat dough on table 1 inch thick. Cut with cutter (12 oz. juice can works) well. Place in a greased round pan. Brush tops with 1 beaten egg mixed with 1 tablespoon water. Bake at 450 degrees for 20 minutes.
